response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and open-source development skills with diverse technical experience, but his background lacks direct C++ development on Windows or fixed-income/capital-markets domain expertise, which are mandatory for this role. His profile is more aligned with web, mobile, and general software development rather than the specialized financial systems required.
strengths: Extensive experience with modern software development practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development).
Strong communication skills and knowledge-sharing demonstrated through workshops and talks.
Diverse technical background with exposure to multiple languages and frameworks.
concerns: No explicit C++ development experience on Windows (mandatory for the role).
Lacks domain expertise in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking.
Recent roles focus heavily on TypeScript/Node.js rather than C++ or SQL-heavy environments.
